description: The SKUs the advisor compares, hand-kept. build.ps1 -Task LicensingData turns this list and Microsoft's service plan CSV into bundles.json (name and features per SKU). A SKU missing from the CSV carries its plans here and is marked verify. requiresBase: the base SKUs an add-on is sold on top of (any one); the advisor offers it only with one of them, held or in the same option (verify against Microsoft's prerequisites). adds: features Microsoft has said a licence includes that its service plan list does not show on that SKU, with the source in addsNote; a held licence brings them like any other of its features. madeOf: the products a suite is made of, as Microsoft describes it (E7 is E5 with Copilot, Entra Suite and Agent 365); the advisor passes over a suite that would bring one of them when the tenant does not hold it and no chosen goal needs it.

skus.addsNote: From 1 July 2026 Enterprise Mobility + Security E3, and so Microsoft 365 E3, includes Intune Plan 2, Remote Help and Advanced Analytics (Microsoft Intune blog, 2026-06-30). Microsoft's service plan list shows none of these plans on this SKU as of 2026-11-23 (verify on a tenant that holds it).

From 1 July 2026 Microsoft 365 E5 includes what E3 gained plus Endpoint Privilege Management, Enterprise App Management and Cloud PKI (Microsoft Intune blog, 2026-06-30). Microsoft's service plan list carries Enterprise App Management and Cloud PKI on a companion SKU, M365_E5_SUITE_COMPONENTS, and none of the others on this SKU as of 2026-11-23 (verify on a tenant that holds it).

Microsoft 365 E7 is Microsoft 365 E5 with Microsoft 365 Copilot, Microsoft Entra Suite and Agent 365 (Microsoft 365 blog, 2026-05-01), so it carries the Intune capabilities E5 gained on 1 July 2026. Microsoft's service plan list shows none of those plans on this SKU as of 2026-11-23 (verify on a tenant that holds it). Its token is E5: every check that asks for E5 is met by E7.

From 1 July 2026 Enterprise Mobility + Security E3, and so Microsoft 365 E3, includes Intune Plan 2, Remote Help and Advanced Analytics (Microsoft Intune blog, 2026-06-30). Microsoft's service plan list shows none of these plans on this SKU as of 2026-11-23 (verify on a tenant that holds it).

An add-on for tenants that already hold Entra ID P2, as its name says: offered only with a licence that brings P2. The list of those is every licence here whose plans include P2, written 2026-11-23.
